Purpose: Static follow-up review of lossless check-log compression before final model freeze
Environment: Local source and saved development receipt reading only; no model/data/target execution
Expected: Evidence compression preserves every check record and reconciliation, without changing model computation, metrics, timing boundaries or acceptance thresholds

checks.Actual: CheckLog creates checks.jsonl.gz exclusively, encodes the same complete check rows, and flushes gzip and underlying stream after each record. Main closes it before writing completion. No check fields or protected paths are dropped.

read_checks decodes gzip with the existing 32MiB bound and parses every JSONL record. Final auditor uses it and still requires all checks PASS and exact completion count reconciliation. Corrupt/incomplete gzip cannot silently satisfy this final audit.

checks.Purpose: Capacity checks remain outside model timing
checks.Actual: Each log append is guarded using uncompressed record bytes plus 32 bytes as conservative append allowance. Check logging and its disk traversal remain outside timed_endpoint. Model routing, 405-call budget, pairing, raw audit, scoring and thresholds retain the reviewed implementation.

Read added test_incremental_gzip_checklog_lossless_and_exclusive: 50 structured Unicode-containing records round-trip exactly and overwrite is rejected. Saved DEVELOPMENT_FRESH_ATTEMPT5.json and DEVELOPMENT_AUDIT_FRESH_ATTEMPT5.json report 14/14 PASS each. These are development reports, not model evidence; this reviewer did not rerun them.

limitations: All scientific, timing and retained-raw limitations in MODEL_STATIC_REVIEW.json remain applicable.

A hard process kill can leave a gzip stream without its final trailer. That is partial failure evidence, not a successful final log; graceful worker cleanup must close it and final auditing must pass.
This is a static follow-up, not numerical revalidation. Actual target capacity and final evidence gates remain mandatory.
status_scope: Static review of compressed evidence handling and unchanged model contract only
